prompt: Staff have been booking patients into slots that start in a few minutes, and the doctor is never ready in time. From now on an appointment must be booked at least 2 hours before its slot starts; a slot starting exactly 2 hours from now is still fine. A booking that is too late must be refused with a new fault code, SLOT_TOO_SOON, which the UI can show like the other refusals (use the status that fits the other rule refusals about timing). Nothing else about booking or cancelling changes.
outOfScope: existing fault codes and their HTTP statuses
the cancellation window and the cancel endpoint
working-hours, daily-cap, slot-uniqueness and patient-record rules
